verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a Python plugin system (Functions, Tools, Pipes, Filters). Its homepage claims a sharing ecosystem ('Share what you build, run what others share'), which implies a community place to get plugins. The evidence never describes browsing a registry or a one-command or one-click install flow, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: documented browsable plugin/skills registry, one-click or one-command install from that registry, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click

citations.quote: Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
